answers.core: Core. Also, there recently was ([#60595](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/60595)), so why not add z axis?
answers.workaround: This can be worked around, however, it would negate the work that was put into making Label3D useful to begin with. If you were to use a texture with text in a billboard scenario, you would have to go back to using a viewport with sprite3d.

title: Add Z Offset for Label3D and Sprite3D Nodes
